# SMP Tijuana

> Professional Scalp Micropigmentation clinic in Tijuana, Mexico. Serving San Diego County and Southern California clients. Starting at $699 USD. Bilingual team (English/Spanish).

## About

SMP Tijuana is a cosmetic micropigmentation studio located at New City Medical Plaza, Paseo del Centenario 9580, Interior 708, Piso 7, Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico. All treatments are performed by Master Estefany Ruiz, a specialist with 7 international certifications in scalp micropigmentation.

Scalp micropigmentation (SMP) is a non-surgical cosmetic procedure that replicates the appearance of hair follicles using micro-deposits of pigment. It does not grow hair. Individual results vary.

## Services

- Full scalp coverage (alopecia, hair loss)
- Hairline design and restoration
- Crown and vertex density
- Scar camouflage
- Hair thinning in women

Pricing starts at $699 USD. Final price is confirmed at a free consultation before any session begins. Most treatments require 2–3 sessions spaced 7–10 days apart.

## Location and logistics

- **Address**: New City Medical Plaza, Paseo del Centenario 9580, Interior 708, Piso 7, 22010 Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico
- **Coordinates**: 32.5027°N, 117.0037°W
- **Distance from border**: ~5 minutes from San Ysidro Port of Entry by rideshare (~$3–5 USD)
- **Hours**: Monday–Friday 09:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–16:00. By appointment only. Sunday closed.
- **Contact**: WhatsApp +52 664 219 0802
- **Languages**: English and Spanish

## For San Diego County clients

US citizens crossing into Mexico by land need a valid US passport book or passport card to re-enter the United States. A REAL ID driver's license is not sufficient for land re-entry. Border requirements can change — verify at [cbp.gov](https://www.cbp.gov/travel/us-citizens/wait-times).

USD is accepted. No appointment deposit required to book a free consultation.

## Compliance notes

- This is a cosmetic procedure, not a medical treatment.
- "Master" is an industry designation, not a government-issued medical title.
- The clinic is not a certified medical facility.
- Individual results vary based on skin type, treatment area, and aftercare.
- Pricing shown is a starting point; final price is confirmed at consultation.
